uncited: Load ray index from `rays_alive[n]` and current distance `t` from `rays_t[n]`.
Calculate current point $(x, y, z)$ by clamping $ox + t \cdot dx$, $oy + t \cdot dy$, $oz + t \cdot dz$ to $[-bound, bound]$.
Map $(x, y, z)$ to grid indices $(nx, ny, nz)$ by clamping $0.5 \cdot (coord \cdot rbound + 1) \cdot H$ to $[0, H-1]$.
Query grid density at index $nx \cdot H \cdot H + ny \cdot H + nz$.
Calculate distance to next voxel boundary in x, y, z using `signf(dx)`, `signf(dy)`, `signf(dz)`.
Compute `tt = t + max(0, min(tx, ty, tz))`.
Advance `t` in a do-while loop until `t >= tt`, using the same `dt` calculation as occupied space.
